text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Oguri Cap has a number
of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I have an idea. Let's go to a hot
spring.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, a hot spring. Come on, get ready.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just think this is the perfect time to go
for a
nice, relaxing bath.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's easy. I just wanna go together
with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ever since my debut, we've done nothing
but run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But now that things have calmed down a
little, I
wanna take you to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs are the best. They soothe
your body
and soul. And most
importantly, they feel great.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want us both to experience that
comfort
together...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Do you not want to come?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Glad to hear it. Then it's decided!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh? What coupon?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh right! The one in the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A friend, huh? I wonder who'd wanna
join me at a
hot spring. Who to ask, who
to ask?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you think you can hold on to
this coupon
for a while?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I totally forgot about that! I
guess
having you hold on to it was the
right choice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're the person I really
wanted to go
with in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All right then! Let's go for a relaxing
soak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew... The water was great!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The way the hot water felt on my skin
was perfect.
This hot spring was so
relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able to come here with
you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I got caught up in my own
excitement.
Were you able to relax too?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good... Hehe, that makes me feel even
warmer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So, what should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
M-maybe I have... But there's actually
something
else I've been looking forward
to.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wanna go for a quick stroll outside?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wow! The stars are really pretty. They're
so...
incredibly beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Take a look for yourself. Ah, I guess I
didn't have
to tell you, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I heard the stars were pretty out here, so
I was
looking forward to taking a walk
with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We've been so focused on our goals that
we
haven't even had a chance to look at
the sky
together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still... It's weird. Even now, we're looking
in the
same direction.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's one thing I can't see changing. I
hope we
can both keep experiencing the
same sights
together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'd really like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm always a little slow at getting my
point across,
so do you mind if we take
our time on this walk?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Oguri Cap and I continue
our stroll
beneath the stars and chat for
long as the night
allows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Oguri Cap and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
